pages.title: Enchanter Charm
pages.description: Hailing from far away in the universe, some Enchanters now find themselves stranded in our world with no means of returning. Thus, they do their best to scavenge and barter with trustworthy mages to gather enough resources to return home. You can earn their trust by handing them over a Blank Parchment which they will bind themselves to to be called upon when needed.
Enchanters were known for their magical prowess, but they seem to have lost their spellcasting as of now. Wonder if they're working on it...

pages.title: Summoning
pages.description: Summon an Enchanter  by using an  Enchanter Charm on a  block. Make sure  you've made their  surroundings safe,  or else they may  wander off and get  lost forever.

pages.title: Trading
pages.description: Enchanters will  trade an assortment  of magical goodies,  gear, and resources  in exchange for  Source Gems. Most  will be happy to help  you upgrade your  gear too, only  asking a small fee  and a reagent to  enchant. If Ars  Additions is  installed,
Enchanters can teach  you unknown glyphs  via Ancient Codices  on sale. If Ars  Ingressum is  installed, they can  even attune a tuning  fork!

pages.title: Snacking
pages.description: Enchanters love  magical snacks and  arch-fruits. When  offered one to eat,  their minds may be  spurred to invent  new items and  refresh their wares.  Careful with the  side-effects of a  given fruit, they're  not immune to the  consequences.
